name: ledgerflow-studio
description: Desktop-first software company operating system for a solo LedgerFlow owner.

scripts.ai:openclaw-plus:check: npm run ai:patch-daemon-entrypoint && npm run ai:patch-daemon-tools && npm run ai:patch-daemon-hardening && npm run ai:patch-telegram-missions && npm run ai:patch-patch-review-routes && npm run ai:patch-ai-workforce-command-center && npm run ai:patch-ai-workforce-snapshot-export && npm run ai:patch-ai-workforce-snapshot-export-ui && node scripts/openclaw-plus-doctor.mjs --skip-patch
scripts.check:company-os: npm run lint && npm run check:agent-tool-ids && npm run check:telegram-missions && npm run check:patch-review-sessions && npm run check:openclaw-plus && npm run check:agentops-contracts && npm run check:ai-workforce-command-center
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:icons && npm run check:env && npm run check:ai-desktop-integration && npm test && npm run check:simulations && npm run check:founder-labs && npm run check:accounting-calculations && npm run check:agent-tool-ids && npm run check:telegram-missions && npm run check:patch-review-sessions && npm run check:openclaw-plus && npm run check:agentops-contracts && npm run check:ai-assistant-safety && npm run check:ai-workforce-command-center && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:offline
scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild server/assistant-daemon-desktop.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/assistant-daemon.cjs
scripts.postbuild: npm run build:manifest && npm run check:build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run prepare:icons && cross-env NODE_ENV=production ELECTRON_DESKTOP=true electron desktop/main.cjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:icons && electron-builder --dir && npm run release:notes
